question.problem: Consider the collection of point masses ${m}_{1}=0.5\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{2}=2\,\text{kg},$ and ${m}_{3}=1\,\text{kg}$ located at ${x}_{1}=2\,\text{m},$ ${x}_{2}=3\,\text{m},$ and ${x}_{3}=5\,\text{m},$ respectively, along the $x$-axis. Find the total moment of this system about the origin.
question.worked_solution:
The moment about the origin $O$ of a collection of masses ${m}_{1},{m}_{2},…,{m}_{n}$ located at ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
{M}_{O}={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i}.
$$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =0.5, & \,{m}_{2} & =2, & \,{m}_{3} & =1, \\ {x}_{1} & =2, & \,{x}_{2} & =3, & \,{x}_{3} & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

We calculate the total moment of this system about the origin as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3} \\  & =0.5\cdot 2+2\cdot 3+1\cdot 5 \\  & =1+6+5 \\  & =12\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the total moment of the system is $12\,\text{kg}\cdot \text{m}.$
